== Matsuyama Shrine (松山神社) ==

'''Matsuyama Shrine''' (松山神社) is the name of multiple '''Shinto shrines''' in Japan.

* {{ill|Matsuyama Shrine (Sōsa, Chiba)|ja|松山神社 (匝瑳市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Matsuyama Shrine (Sōsa, Chiba)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} – Located in '''Sōsa City, Chiba Prefecture'''.
* {{ill|Matsuyama Shrine (Kiyosu, Aichi)|ja|松山神社 (清須市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Matsuyama Shrine (Kiyosu, Aichi)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} – Located in '''Kiyosu City, Aichi Prefecture'''.
* {{ill|Matsuyama Shrine (Osaka, Osaka)|ja|松山神社 (大阪市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Matsuyama Shrine (Osaka, Osaka)|1=Matsuyamajinsha|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11529909}} – Located in '''Osaka City, Osaka Prefecture'''.
* {{ill|Matsuyama Shrine (Matsuyama, Ehime)|ja|松山神社 (松山市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Matsuyama Shrine (Matsuyama, Ehime)|1=Matsuyama Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11529911}} – Located in '''Matsuyama City, Ehime Prefecture'''.
* {{ill|Matsuyama Shrine (Shibushi, Kagoshima)|ja|松山神社 (志布志市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Matsuyama Shrine (Shibushi, Kagoshima)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} – Located in '''Shibushi City, Kagoshima Prefecture'''.
